facts.fact: The Public Procurement and Concessions Commission's 2024 report says the World Bank-funded e-GP system went live in 2024 as a pilot in six entities (finance, health, public works, education ministries, the revenue authority and the Commission), with enrolment of 50 more entities expected.

LBR.note: The Liberia Business Registry is named only as a planned e-GP integration; nothing on its registration.
IFMIS is named only as a planned e-GP integration; no statement of core systems in use.
Only World Bank funding of a public system, which is not private money.
Nothing on consultation on a digital law or policy.
